categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies wallet block scanning in `src/wallet/scan.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a wallet rescan bug where transactions are silently missed and incorrect balances are reported on wallet restore or descriptor import. The description notes that when a transaction paying outside the lookahead pool precedes a pool-expanding transaction in the same block, "the earlier transaction is ignored; the wallet reports an incorrect balance without warning unless an explicit second rescan is performed."
